detailZones.title: Checkpoint queue and divestiture
detailZones.description: Follow the empty queuing lane alongside its belt barriers, sign stands and wheeled cart of trays.

detailZones.title: Document check podium
detailZones.description: Find the desk behind the clear screen, its keyboard shelf and the small trays beside it.

detailZones.title: Baggage screening and conveyors
detailZones.description: Compare the enclosed baggage scanner with the open detector arch, roller bed and colored trays.

detailZones.title: Secondary inspection
detailZones.description: Look across the inspection desk for the lamp, shallow trays, swivel stool, pump bottle and wastebasket.

detailZones.title: Sterile departure exit
detailZones.description: Find the glass gate, seats, clock and exit in the waiting area beyond the inspection tables.

anchorAudit.rationale: The queue fittings, trays, desk furniture, scanner shell, inspection table and departure seats were matched to the final checkpoint photograph. The nearest post has a visible shaft and cap. An independent collar, document reader functions and scanner modality cannot be identified, so those words remain available in the index.
